review_status: All fourteen normal, larger-text and narrow states inspected; comparison supplied for parent review. No whole-screen pixel-equality or Founder visual-approval claim.
review_files: COMPARE_*.png are original master left / actual widget render right; CONTACT_* pages are review indexes.
remaining_differences: Actual Flutter canvas is rectangular; locked masters include rounded device corners.

Normal type metrics, line wraps, card height, bubble spacing, scroll position and empty-state vertical placement differ modestly from the master. Current/past header cards sit slightly lower; photos retain the actual provider crop.

At 1.3 text scale, cards and menus grow and actions/status stack. At 320 points the title wraps and topic row scrolls; these variants are accessibility evidence against the single normal-size master, not alternate approved design masters.
The same existing transcript is retained in All; viewport content can differ after wrapping/autoscroll.
